content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p11","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Old treasures and quiet halls, a good place to let the week settle."},{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A thousand wooden faces, all watching you decide where to stand."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Go early, before the selfie sticks wake up, and let the green do the talking."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Shoes off, phone down, eyes up in the garden; the pond has been patient for centuries."},{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Nightingale floors squeak like polite gossip, so walk softly and listen."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"Foxes and vermilion gates all the way up; go early, before the crowds learn to walk."},{"poi_id":"p14","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Steel wheels and shinkansen noses; even the non-train people will slow down here."},{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The wooden stage hangs over the maples like a dare; the view does the rest."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"Gold leaf that makes even the crows look underdressed. Go early, before the tour buses learn to queue."},{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A canal path with enough quiet to hear your own thoughts, and the occasional heron judging them."},{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Silver pavilion, no silver, still worth the walk. The moss garden is the real show."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m5","note":"Graze the stalls before the crowds learn your name."},{"poi_id":"p19","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A gentle, halal-friendly plate that still feels like Kyoto."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Walk slowly here; the old wood has better stories than the signs."},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Lantern light, narrow lanes, and the city pretending it never grew up."},{"poi_id":"p19","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Back for a quiet dinner before the night gets ideas."}]}
Lanterns, gates, gold, temples — every must-do tucked in, and the blossoms won’t wait.
